messages:
rachel: heads up we're planning to migrate legacy boolean flags for per-tenant throttles into the new typed-runtime-config this week. main goals: safer rollouts, per-tenant quotas, and better telemetry tagging. want quick alignment on the API shape and console preview expectations.

josh: +1. biggest concern is preserving existing semantics for tenants that relied on simple on/off. the new type needs backward-compatible defaults and a simple upgrade path (auto-convert to enforce=false).

priya: also we should support a sampled-enforcement mode. allow N% of requests to be routed under the new quota logic while the rest follow the old path. that gives us visibility without full cutover.

ben: agreed. sample mode is a must. here's a minimal patch shape proposal:
```
PATCH /api/v1/runtime/configs/tenants/flags/{tenant_id}
{
  "name": "inference_quota_policy",
  "type": "quota_policy_v2",
  "policy": {
    "mode": "sampled",    // one of [\"off\", \"sampled\", \"enforce\"]
    "sample_pct": 5,      // only in sampled mode
    "token_budget": 1_000_000,
    "reset_window_secs": 3600
  },
  "guardrails": {
    "err_rate_delta_pct": 0.5,
    "p99_ms_delta_pct": 20
  },
  "migration": {
    "preserve_legacy": true,
    "auto_promote_after_days": 7
  }
}
```

rachel: this looks good. two UX asks: 1) console should show a per-tenant preview for the last 24h including estimated quota burn and request-level sampling hits; 2) ability to run a "simulate" job that replays a small window against the new policy and surfaces disagreements count.

josh: simulate job power is great but expensive. suggest default to an approximate estimator for preview and surface a button "run full simulate" that enqueues a replay job (costs credits).

priya: telemetry gating: we want the runtime to emit a new metric series override_id=<id> and include fields: applied_mode, sample_pct, legacy_path_hit. then alerts can be tied to that series. also add an annotation to traces with the override id for easier SLO investigation.

ben: infra-bot: can you create a required CI check that validates the migration schema and that no tenant is auto-promoted if they have >10% traffic from legacy clients?

infra-bot: created check: "runtime-migration-schema" and gate: "no-auto-promote-high-legacy-traffic". failing runs post comment. :gear:

rachel: rollout policy: default to sampled at 1% for 24h, then 5% for 24h, then stop and require manual promote to enforce. Make these configurable per-tenant.

josh: and add a quick rollback endpoint that flips mode back to off/enforce old semantics with correlation id so we can query metrics in the rollback window. e.g. POST /api/v1/runtime/overrides/{id}/rollback

priya: console integration detail: preview card should show three panels: cost impact (tokens), correctness signals (regressions count from eval hooks), and traffic split visualization (legacy vs new path). also include an estimated confidence % for the estimator.

ben: we should also add a server-side safety limit: if simulated or sampled telemetry reports err_rate_delta_pct > guardrails.err_rate_delta_pct OR p99_ms_delta_pct > guardrails.p99_ms_delta_pct -> auto-suspend sampled ramp and create a PagerDuty incident if oncall is subscribed.

rachel: perfect. i'll write the RFC with the API proto, console mockups, and the default rollout schedule. assigning owners: josh on runtime server changes, priya on metrics/trace integration, ben on infra checks and simulate job, i'll own console UX and the RFC text.

josh: i'll open the OpenAPI PR shortly. tagging @ben for infra review and @infra-bot will enforce schema CI.

infra-bot: PR template updated: add runtime-migration-schema check to required checks for the next 2 weeks.

rachel: thanks team. aim to start a canary for one internal tenant Friday 02:00 UTC. will post the RFC link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
